title: Despite economic problems, Undas flower vendors strive to survive
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Despite problems with the economy, this year’s profit for flower vendors outside the Manila South Cemetery is enough to make ends meet as they see fewer competitors this year.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Despite problems with the economy, this year’s profit for flower vendors outside the Manila South Cemetery is enough to make ends meet as they see fewer competitors this year. With arranged flowers lined up in the sidewalk, Bryan Amoyan is ready to pack his products once the gate of the cemetery closes
